title: Insane Wife Threatens Husband With A Hammer
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On November 23rd, 2023. A distraught husband came to the station in regards to his crazy wife who had violated a civil protection order he placed on her by making threats at him. When police showed up to her house, she refused to leave and demanded police to leave. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
